reproducibility: Primary PDF directly links public code at github.com/Futuresis/replay-agent-recorder and the MettleBench dataset at github.com/Kelvin-Coffee/MettleBench.
MettleBench has 82 tasks with hidden ordered executable acceptance criteria derived from five engineering benchmark sources.

main_matched_results.runs: mean ± sample SD over n=3 independent runs

primary_verified_evidence.paired_failed_state_recovery: From 50 identical failed Continue endpoints, paired recovery is 8.0% for Continue versus 30.0% for AgentRewind; checklist-progress change 5.1 versus 12.2 pp.
primary_verified_evidence.external_benchmark: On full Terminal-Bench 2.0 under the same termination condition: Continue 78.7 success / 88.7 criteria passed; Restart 70.8 / 79.2; AgentRewind 83.1 / 90.2.
primary_verified_evidence.statistical_tests: Task-paired Wilcoxon comparisons favor AgentRewind in all 12 model×metric×baseline comparisons; 11/12 remain significant after Holm correction. The sole nonsignificant corrected comparison is GPT-5.4-mini task success vs Restart (pHolm=0.102), while checklist progress remains significant.
primary_verified_evidence.recovery_boundary: Primary paper explicitly states workspace filesystem state is restored, but network requests, external-service calls and runtime state outside the controlled workspace cannot be undone.

judgment: Upgrade B -> A-. The exact execution-strategy values, component ablations, paired failed-state recovery experiment, cross-harness results, statistical tests, public code/data, and irreversibility scope are all directly verified in the primary PDF. Evidence is unusually strong for the scoped claim that aligned context+controlled-environment rollback plus retained failure memory improves recovery on these engineering tasks. Keep A- rather than treating it as externally replicated consensus because it is a very recent preprint and restoration excludes external side effects.
exact_continuation: Search for independent reproduction or failure analysis of AgentRewind, especially tasks with irreversible external side effects and checkpoint-cost accounting. Preserve the primary boundary: filesystem/control-plane rewind is not world-state rollback.
